fields.Name: IT190 - Comms V2 Activity Worker and GDPR Erasure
fields.Description: Exercises CommsActivityWorker event processing, deduplication, SoftBounceThresholdPolicy auto-suppression, EraseEndpointPII, and click correlation by TrackingToken against the live database. In-process by design: these checks pin the worker's own rules with event shapes and repeat deliveries a public route cannot be made to produce. The path a real event takes (public route, work queue, MJAPI's registered handler) is covered over the wire by IT191.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Hard bounce and soft bounce thresholds create suppressions, duplicate events are skipped, EraseEndpointPII scrubs PII while preserving compliance records, and a verified click is recorded against its log without suppressing the endpoint.
